rules.description: Every answer has exactly one closed evidence status.
Supported answers contain at least one structurally resolvable evidence_id.
Supported-with-qualification answers contain evidence and a visible qualification.
Owner assertions contain a named fictional owner and a closed customer approval state.
Open answers contain an unresolved open item and are not represented as resolved.
Every evidence reference resolves by evidence_id to an inventory record and existing relative file.
Every outward-facing artifact visibly contains the synthetic banner.
The term verified is not used without a named mechanism and bounded scope.
Manifest hashes match the listed files.
Outputs contain no secret-like data, customer data, real infrastructure details, or private absolute paths.
The authoring receipt claims only checks actually executed.
A future PDF must contain the same ordered question_id set as the spreadsheet.
